name: Follow
guided_description: Make NPC(s) travel with the player. Followers, housecarls and paid hirelings follow on the first request; others only with a real reason (debt, shared goal, love). Guards on duty, jarls, merchants and busy workers refuse.
note: EXPERIMENTAL: May cause NPC AI packages to break.
prompt: If the player asks you to follow them, and you are thoroughly convinced to do so, begin your response with '{key}:'
